skill.summary: Manage customer expectations, order changes, and post-purchase support for long-lead custom products (engraved necklaces, custom pet portraits, personalized...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial framework and reference resources added for custom-order support.

- Introduced detailed support workflow and structured response templates for managing long-lead custom orders.
- Added clear procedures for status updates, modification requests (including 24-hour change window), and post-purchase quality/return handling.
- Included new reference documents for policies (references/policy.md, references/faq.md).
- Provided a script (scripts/calculate_eta.py) to automate ETA calculations for production and delivery.
- Outlined proactive communication strategy and key customer experience metrics.
- Added evaluation and documentation files for easier onboarding and future improvements.
